notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 - Hotfixes
notes.notes:
The bug caused by the previous update has been fixed.
My apologies for any inconvenience this may have caused.

The fixes are as follows
・The problem that sometimes an invisible jump-scare occurs.
・Enemy cries were sometimes not heard when clearing the game.
・Enemies behave strangely depending on where they appear.
The problem that the viewpoint operation becomes unstable depending on the FPS setting.
・I have also found other issues and can reproduce them.

I will fix other problems as soon as I can find or reproduce them.

Also, I have updated the development software to make development more comfortable.
Due to this, a large number of files will be updated when the game is updated.
If you have any problems, please feel free to contact me.

notes.title: Update to deepen world view
notes.notes:
Hello!
I have made the following updates to this issue.
・Placed text materials in the stage.
・Adjusted the conversation with some of the mannequins.
・Translated some of the points that were pointed out to me.

If you like, you can talk with the mannequins.
You may learn something about the situation in the company.

The translation data has been updated to reflect the addition of the new text.
If the translation is not good enough, please let me know.
You can find the link to the translation data in the previous thread.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1802330/view/3096792662633080055

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: In-game convenience improvements, other bug fixes and progress
notes.notes:
In-game convenience improvements, other bug fixes and progress

Hello everyone!
I have made the following modifications to the system.

Fixes
・Reflected translations provided by volunteers.
・Addition of stamina gauge
・The time to run out of stamina was changed to 20 seconds.
・Change in the speed of stamina recovery
・Changed the game menu so that the number of cursed statues remaining can be checked from the game menu.
・Fixed a bug that prevented achievements from being unlocked.
・Fixed a bug that caused item effects to be triggered when equipping weapons under certain conditions.
・Other minor adjustments

Thank you for your ongoing bug reports and requests.
If you have any problems with this update, please feel free to post a comment.

The new map is in the works!
It is still going to take some time and I hope to be able to add some maps for mini-games.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Other language updates + bug fixes
notes.notes:
The following languages are now supported.
・French
・Portuguese
・Polish
・Thai
・Turkish
・Spanish
・Italian
・German

Fixed bugs
・When moving left or right, the movement appears to be choppy.
・The other side of the wall is visible.
・A problem where the movement of the spectator camera is choppy.

Improvements have been made
・Improved detection of enemies near stairs.


Please feel free to contact us if you have any problems.

Thank you all!

notes.title: Difficulty adjustment update. Other bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Difficulty has been adjusted. 

The following changes have been made to the difficulty level. 
・Removed easy mode and added hard mode.
・Increase in overall difficulty
・Decrease in the number of medical kits
1player (9~12) => (7~10) 
4player (9~12*1.5) => (7~10*1.5)

Other bug fixes
・Fixed a bug in which the icon and the activated skill were mismatched when using multiple potions.
・Fixed an issue where the clear movie would not play on the client side.
・Solved a problem that made it difficult to pass through the door when lagging was occurring.
・Reduced the load on the GPU for the player character's hair.

I am looking forward to hearing from you. 
If you have any problems, please feel free to post them in the thread.
I hope you continue to enjoy the game.
